user.title: MSEDCL (Mahavitaran) account
user.description: Enter your Mahavitaran app login and your 12-digit consumer number. Billing unit, AMISP code and smart-meter capability are discovered automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Update MSEDCL credentials
reauth_confirm.description: MSEDCL rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

error.invalid_auth: MSEDCL rejected the login or password
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the MSEDCL servers
error.invalid_consumer_no: Consumer number must be 12 digits and known to MSEDCL

abort.already_configured: This consumer number is already configured

init.title: Polling intervals
init.description: Smart-meter data is roughly 15 minutes old on MSEDCL's side; polling faster than 30 minutes gains nothing. The statistics interval controls how often the Energy Dashboard catches up.

api_drift.title: MSEDCL API may have changed
api_drift.description: The {coordinator} updates have failed with repeated server errors. This usually means MSEDCL changed their unofficial API (the same failure mode that broke the RecentBill endpoint), not that your credentials expired. Check for an integration update, or open an issue with diagnostics attached.
